purpose: One prespecified repair of the unstable training recipe; training-side development only, not a contribution or augmentation-benefit test.
basis: The reproduced failure involved rapid backbone/last-block activation shrinkage after large updates, while identical final weights gave the same failure onCPU. Reduce pretrained-body target learning rate by10x and ramp both groups for a fixed128steps, avoiding an abrupt update to a pretrained representation under a random head. This is a conservative joint repair, not identification of the sole cause.

unchanged: BN runningstats fixed with affine trainable
official ResNet18 V1 initial backbone and seed0Linear512to2 head

checkpoint_contents: At128and1024 save model weights+metadata. At2048 also save momentum and optimizer paramgroups. Retain every key checkpoint; no best-checkpoint selection.

success_criteria.completion: Both arms2048updates and all loss/gradient/parameter checks finite.
success_criteria.clean_learning: Each arm clean-training loss at both1536and2048 <=0.5 of its initial clean-training loss.
success_criteria.own_distribution_learning: TA fixed256training-view probe loss at both1536and2048 <=0.5 of its initial value. Base own distribution is its clean-training probe.
success_criteria.online_learning: For each arm mean online loss over final256updates <=0.5 of mean over first256updates.
success_criteria.no_old_collapse: At2048 each arm mean feature variance across64trainingimages >1e-4 of its initial value and >1 unique logit vector.
success_criteria.note: Operational training-recovery checks, not universal scientific thresholds; no accuracy gate or generalization inference. Failure means this single recipe was not established within the fixed budget, not proof of useless augmentation.

stop_criteria: Any nonfinite loss,gradient or parameter: stop both arms and preserve available state.
An arm simultaneously has clean loss>=0.95*initial and variance<=1e-4*initial at two consecutive recorded nonzero checkpoints: stop both as recurrent severe collapse.
